Name: New Heat
Description: Post a song that came out in the last 3 months.

Name: Spotify Age
Description: Everyone saw their spotify wrapped. I know because we all needed spotify to sign in. So take what your Spotify age is… and go back that many years and pick a song from that year. Mine was 67 (the kids love it I know) so I need to chose a song from 1958. Woof.

Name: On the Map (submitted by Spund)
Description: Songs referencing something you’d find on a map in the title (Cities, Roads, Landmarks, etc). Imaginary places are welcome. Funkytown, however, is not @Tim

Name: Gezellig (submitted by Zeez!)
Description: Gezellig: a quintessential Dutch word describing a feeling of coziness, conviviality, and togetherness, often in a warm, pleasant atmosphere with good company, encompassing concepts like comfort, friendliness, and enjoyable social connection

Name: Oh boy… here comes Mendo and a trip down south….
Description: For this challenge we're taking a family trip. Bring us something special from our neighbors down south. Cumbia, samba, banda, raggaeton -- whatever gets your hips moving, body sweating and uncharacteristically open to a wild night with Ricardo, your dark, sultry waiter.

Name: Shhhhhh it’s all going to be alright (from Mendo)
Description: A gift for Kenny and Ricky's soon-to-be 2am bottle feedings and to Sam/Brandon and Fluff. Something quiet and wondrous. Songs that say yes, it might be unconscionably selfish to bring a new life into certain environmental and geopolitical catastrophe leading to constant human suffering surely to be exacerbated by the rise of AI and the insatiable greed of our tech overlords, but there are still life affirming glimmers of hope and beauty if you look closely.

Name: The Voice (from disk who gave to kenny)
Description:
Submit a song where the vocal performance is the defining force of the track.

This force does not have to be loud or pitch-perfect. It can come from control, phrasing, vulnerability, attitude, tension, restraint, etc. What matters is that the performance feels intentional and irreplaceable. 

Any genre, era, language... belting, delicate, growling... male, female, somewhere in between... whatever!

Doesnt have to just be one person (harmonies/tradeoffs/whatever). The vocal component of the track.

Name: We Shall Overcome (from Rick)
Description: Music has always had the power to inspire social change. Pick a protest song that invigorated a movement through both its message and musical quality.

Name: Planes Trains and Automobiles (from Paug!)
Description:
Means of transportation are an integral part of our lives. Musicians have to spend a lot of their time traveling between gigs and I have to assume that gives them inspiration when writing music. Those aren’t pillows! They’re tunes!

Pick a song that includes mention of any type of vehicle in the song name. Instrumental or not. Any genre will do. 

Guaranteed point from me if it’s trains. Choo choo bitches!

Name: Earworms (Timmy...AGAIN!)
Description: We all know a song that just gets stuck in our heads. It might not be good but there’s something about it we can’t forget. We might all hate each other after this round but I don’t care! This playlist might be trash but it will be memorable.

Name: Song Safari: Hunting in the Wild.
Description:
It’s Pokémon Go, but for music.

Your mission is simple: find a song in the wild — at a trendy bar, an overpriced coffee shop, a dusty record store, or anywhere music finds you — and use Shazam (or your app of choice) to “catch” it. No scrolling through playlists at home — this round is about getting out there and letting the world DJ for you. When you post, share where you were when you discovered the track. Honor system engaged… happy hunting!

Name: New Orleans! (from spund!)
Description: America’s great music city! Pick a song by an artist from New Orleans.

Name: Flying Under The Gaydar (from Dianna)
Description: Pick a song from a queer artist who has never had a Top 10 hit on the Billboard Hot 100. I’m talking more obscure artists (no Elton John, no Lady Gaga, no Queen) who identify as part of the LGBTQIA community. (If it’s a band, at least 1 member has to be queer.) Let’s find & share some dope shit. Happy hunting! 🏳️‍🌈

Name: Locked in (from Josh Storm)
Description:
Locked in:
You’re on deck going for Olympic gold in the snowboard competition in Milan. You’re staring down the half pipe watching your competitors. The snow is coming down. There’s thousands of people watching in person and millions more on tv. You’ve got one run left. Adrenaline is at an all time high but you gotta keep it together too. Headphones are in. What are you listening to?

Name: Covers! (from Mendo)
Description: Pick a cover that changes how you hear the original. Something that introduces something new musically to a song you may have heard a million times and makes you appreciate both versions even more. Must be a different genre from original.

Name: Feel Good Tunes (From Dianna 2 wins)
Description: The days are getting longer, the weather is warming up, and the snow & ice are finally starting to melt. By grace of Jah, there is a random, 75 degree day that appears in the middle of March, just as you were about to give up hope & yeet yourself into oblivion. On this same day, your boss/child/anyone holding you responsible for anything happens to say, "You know what, homie? You've been doing a GREAT job with things lately. Here is a free pass to take the day off & do WHATEVER YOU WANT!" So you grab your headphones & head out the door to take a stroll in this gorgeous, warm, live-giving sunshine. You are filled to the brim with joy & happiness, grateful for this respite from *gestures broadly.* It's time to fill your ears with a song that just makes you *FEEL GOOD* no matter how many times you listen to it. What are we listening to?

Name: Colors (from Zeez x 2!)
Description: Don’t think too hard. Pick a song with a color in the title.

Name: Jerky Jingle (from Mendo)
Description: You've been hired by an upstart food company to select their new theme music. The disheveled, oddly furry CEO instructs: "Grab your pencil. Timber Jerky shreds in your mouth so give me something that f'n shreds. I want an iconic guitar riff. It also has to reference one of our two dozen protein offerings.  Think hard on this one partner.

Name: The Future (from Asa)
Description: Pick a song that sounds like it comes from the future. (editors note: awesome job Asa!!)

Name: The Perfect Song™️ (and guess who 👀)
Description: We all have them. They are on a short list. The perfect songs do exist in our minds. I’m convinced they are a perfect combination of both objective and subjective. Objective cause others really do understand why you consider them perfect. Little platonic ideals that we hold in a heart and others share with. But subjective because of course they are so personal to us. We keep returning. They just hit the right buttons inside our hearts minds and souls. From first note to the last. Here’s the wrinkle though…. It’s a tight season we need to make this spicy…. So when you vote on the song you have to guess who submitted it. Guess correctly, receive an extra point. Let’s the stress build to submit what you think is a perfect song but also with the right end game strategy. It’s a pleasure being your commish. Enjoy 😈
